reasons: The inserted Section 9(c) supplies every atomic element of the preferred position: professional and workmanlike Services (90 days), 12-month conformance of deliverables and software to documentation, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and repair/replacement/refund remedies.
The insertion is a concise new subsection addressing an entirely absent performance warranty; no existing sentence was rewritten and no extra exceptions or boilerplate were added.

Existing mutual authority warranties in 9(a) and the Globix carve-out in 9(b) remain untouched and effective; the only minor drafting note is reliance on the capitalized term "Services", which tracks the Agreement's service obligations and does not create a contradiction or dangling mechanic.
